# Project brief

Memory Test shows 15 random words, one at a time (1.5 s each). The player types what they remember, then sees their recall by position, plus an explanation of the primacy–recency effect and how it applies to LLM context windows.

v1 goal: turn the single-file v0 into an app where players can create an account, keep a history, and compare scores on a leaderboard. This builds real data across many games to show the U-shaped serial-position curve.

Owner: Tuan Luu. The project is also a learning vehicle for working with Claude Code and the superpowers workflow (brainstorm → spec → plan → execute → review).
